name: Quantum Sound Pro ANC Wireless Headphones

specifications.battery_life: Up to 30 hours of playtime with ANC OFF, 24 hours with ANC ON
specifications.charging: USB-C fast charging: 10 minutes gives 4 hours of playback. Full charge takes 90 minutes
specifications.noise_cancellation: Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation up to 40dB with Transparency Mode
specifications.drivers: 40mm custom bio-cellulose dynamic drivers with deep bass tuning
specifications.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3 with dual-device multipoint pairing support
specifications.water_resistance: IPX4 splash and sweat resistant (not suitable for swimming or heavy rain)
specifications.microphone: Quad-mic array with AI environmental noise reduction for calls

commercial_terms.emi_available: No-cost EMI available on major credit cards starting at INR 999/month

policies.warranty: 1-Year comprehensive manufacturer replacement warranty against functional defects
policies.returns: 7-day replacement policy for manufacturing defects. Non-returnable once opened unless defective
policies.box_contents: Headphones, USB-C charging cable, 3.5mm audio aux cable, carrying pouch, quick start guide

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I connect two devices at the same time?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes, Quantum Sound Pro supports Dual Multipoint Bluetooth pairing allowing seamless switching between laptop and smartphone.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Is the charger included?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: A USB-C charging cable is included in the box; a wall adapter is not included.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Is it waterproof for swimming?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: No, it is IPX4 splash resistant for workouts and light rain only. It cannot be submerged.
